calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked. Vistra, like Constellation, is a profitable power company with real earnings and contracts — the boring, profitable version of the AI-power play rather than a moonshot.
calls.base_case: Profitable generator with real contracts; grows with electricity demand.
calls.bull_case: Power demand growth lifts the profitable generators.
calls.bear_case: AI demand disappoints and the sector stays depressed.
